bio.text: Robert Jackson is a Democratic member of the New York State Senate for District 31, in office since January 1, 2019, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
According to a Cornell ILR School profile, his first elected position was School Board President and he later served 12 years on the New York City Council.

The same profile says he spent 23 years in the labor movement, beginning at the state Department of Labor and later working for the Public Employees Federation, and that he chairs the Senate Civil Service & Pensions Committee.
